blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — After Vice President Sara Duterte described the Philippine National Police as an “enforcement arm” of politicians, agency chief Gen. Jose Melencio Nartatez Jr. stressed that police must remain impartial and uphold due process in all operations Nartatez, in a statement on Sunday, said: “Impartiality is a principle that we strive to uphold in every police operation and public service.” He added: “Our commitment is to treat everyone with fairness, respect, and compassion, while providing equal protection under the law regardless of one’s position or political affiliation.” READ: LIVE: VP Sara Duterte Impeachment Day 45 Household staffers held captive?
